name: zambo-ai
summary: Official Python SDK for Zambo (zambo.dev), the verifiable work layer for AI: tools behind one MCP endpoint (https://zambo.dev/mcp) over plain JSON-RPC, a verifiable receipt for every job. Includes SpendGuard: a hard per-call and per-day cap in front of your agent wallet, refusals recorded. Plus costcalc: prices an agent loop (expected, worst case, uncapped runaway rate) and generates a spend policy sized to the worst case. No account, no API key. Free: 20 calls + 1 wrap-up free every day; pickup free.
author: Brennan Zambo
